paths.description: Entry/catalog template and legally required adult/consent gate; covers global navigation, consent, preference, performance, security, SEO and content-grid behavior.
Best-videos archive/listing template; covers pagination, scrolled navigation, catalog density and mobile reflow.
Representative video detail template selected from the entry page; covers title hierarchy, media-detail layout, related content and cookie consent.
Account login/create archetype; DOM-only inspection of labels, required state and autofill semantics without creating or modifying an account.
Deliberately invalid route to assess not-found messaging and recovery.

findings.summary: The interface does not follow the system dark-color preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot retains the same light gray page and white consent surface, while the quality probe reports colorScheme "normal".
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and theme surfaces with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Several controls and text combinations fail contrast requirements.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports the color-contrast audit as failing (accessibility score 0.62).
findings.suggestedFix: Raise foreground/background contrast for all text and interactive states and verify at WCAG AA ratios.

findings.summary: Navigation between the listing and detail templates is an abrupt full-page replacement.
findings.evidence: Representative listing and detail captures show separate document loads, and DOM/CSS inspection found no View Transition usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for same-origin listing-to-detail navigation with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The blocking age/cookie prompt is a custom overlay rather than a semantic dialog.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no dialog, role=dialog, or popover element even though the first viewport is blocked by a modal prompt.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a modal <dialog>, label it, manage initial/return focus, and provide platform Escape/light-dismiss behavior where appropriate.

findings.summary: The listing template overflows a 360 px viewport after consent.
findings.evidence: The /best layout capture measured scrollWidth 643 px against clientWidth 360 px, an overflow of 283 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed/minimum widths, preserve a valid mobile viewport, and use fluid/intrinsic sizing for the listing grid and overlays.

findings.summary: The entry path paints and becomes useful too slowly.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 6.5 s, LCP 7.7 s and Speed Index 10.0 s; the independent trace measured LCP 7.05 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten the critical path, prioritize the LCP resource, and avoid the alias redirect.

findings.summary: Late content shifts make the mobile load unstable.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout observer measured CLS 0.343 across four shifts; 99 of 100 images lack explicit dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image/media space with width and height or aspect-ratio and stabilize injected consent/content regions.

findings.summary: Resource delivery is heavy and blocks rendering.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 122 requests and 2.73 MB transferred, with a VeryHigh parser stylesheet and parser scripts; Lighthouse estimates 3.84 s render-blocking savings and 1.4 s redirect savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate the typo-domain redirect, inline only critical CSS, defer noncritical scripts, set long cache lifetimes, and prioritize the LCP resource.

findings.summary: Most shipped CSS and JavaScript is unused on the entry path.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 206 KiB unused CSS and 579 KiB unused JavaScript; the largest script transfers 517 KiB.
findings.suggestedFix: Split bundles by template, remove legacy/unused code, and load media-player dependencies only when needed.

findings.summary: Many controls and content images lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails button-name, link-name and image-alt; the image primitive reports 98 of 100 images without alt, and the DOM probe lists numerous unnamed buttons.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every actionable control a discernible name and every informative image meaningful alt text; use empty alt for decoration.

findings.summary: Text and controls do not consistently meet accessible contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails the color-contrast audit on the representative entry page.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust the palette and all interactive states to meet WCAG AA contrast.

findings.summary: The entry template has no heading structure and its accessibility tree is malformed.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found zero h1/h2/h3 elements on the home page; Lighthouse reports agent/accessibility tree problems and unnamed links/buttons.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1, hierarchical section headings, landmarks, and a coherent keyboard/focus order.

findings.summary: The rendered viewport configuration restricts user zoom and the listing does not reflow.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails meta-viewport because maximum-scale is below 5 or user-scalable=no is present; /best overflows by 283 px at 360 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow pinch zoom, remove restrictive viewport directives, ensure 400% reflow, and retain adequately sized targets.

findings.summary: Image markup omits intrinsic sizing across almost the entire catalog grid.
findings.evidence: The images primitive reports 99 of 100 images without width/height; Lighthouse also flags unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width and height for every thumbnail and use aspect-ratio for responsive sizing.

findings.summary: The page uses deprecated browser APIs and ships legacy JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports one deprecation warning and estimates 52 KiB of legacy JavaScript savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the deprecated API, target a modern Baseline, and remove unnecessary legacy transforms.

findings.summary: Some links are not crawlable and the mobile viewport is restrictive.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails crawlable-anchors and meta-viewport; the /best mobile layout overflows 283 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations for navigation and a nonrestrictive width=device-width viewport.

findings.summary: The typo-domain redirect does not expose a canonical URL in the rendered document.
findings.evidence: The entry URL 302 redirects to xvideos.com, while the DOM probe returned no link rel=canonical.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-referencing canonical on the destination and make alternate/redirect indexing signals consistent.

findings.summary: The entry page has no structured data or social-preview metadata.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph properties among the rendered meta elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Add schema.org JSON-LD for the catalog/site and complete Open Graph/Twitter metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Important transport and content security headers are missing or weakened.
findings.evidence: The header probe found no HSTS or X-Content-Type-Options and a CSP permitting unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.
findings.suggestedFix: Enable HSTS and nosniff, remove unsafe CSP sources with nonces/hashes, and progressively constrain the broad allowlist.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The header probe found no Permissions-Policy and no HSTS; Referrer-Policy is the permissive legacy no-referrer-when-downgrade value.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, strict referrer policy, HSTS, and CSP frame-ancestors/Trusted Types where compatible.

findings.summary: The multilingual UI is not prepared for bidirectional layout.
findings.evidence: The page correctly declares lang=en, but the quality probe found no dir declaration and no logical CSS properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction with locale where needed and replace physical left/right sizing and spacing with logical properties.

findings.summary: Consent choices are visually asymmetric.
findings.evidence: On the detail path, “Enter and accept all cookies” is the dominant red action while “Reject all cookies” is a small underlined link lower in the modal.
findings.suggestedFix: Give accept and reject equal prominence and separate age confirmation from optional cookie consent.

findings.summary: Sign-in and sign-up fields omit standard autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The account probe shows email/login and current-password fields with empty autocomplete values; only new-password fields declare a token.
findings.suggestedFix: Use username/email, current-password, new-password and other appropriate autocomplete tokens on account forms.

findings.summary: Account authentication lacks modern credential assistance.
findings.evidence: The account form exposes password-based sign-in with missing current-password/username autocomplete and no observed WebAuthn/passkey affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct autofill tokens and offer passkey registration/sign-in with a recoverable password fallback.

findings.summary: The thumbnail grid ships unresponsive legacy images.
findings.evidence: The image primitive reports 99 legacy-format images, 100 without srcset, and 90 below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive srcsets, size thumbnails to display density, and lazy-load below-fold media.

findings.summary: The entry path has a large CDN and media transfer budget.
findings.evidence: The HAR records 2.73 MB across 122 requests, including 1.63 MB of images and 2.73 MB classified off the typo-domain origin.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a per-template byte/request budget, lazy-load catalog media, cache immutable assets, and remove the redirect overhead.
